title: govwatch
description: Ingestion health for congress.gov and regulations.gov, plus what's moving in the data.

panels.title: Ingestion lag
panels.description: Time since the last successful run per source. SLO: under 30 minutes, 99% of the time.

panels.title: Newest record age
panels.description: Age of the newest stored record. congress.gov timestamps are whole days, so 1-3 days there is normal.

panels.title: Lag SLO budget left (30d)
panels.description: Share of the 30-day error budget (1% of the time over 30 min lag) still unspent. Negative means the SLO is breached.

panels.title: Records seen vs actually changed (per hour)
panels.description: The gap between the two is re-fetched data the content hash filtered out.

panels.title: Rate limit headroom
panels.description: Share of the api.data.gov hourly limit left. regulations.gov keys get 1,000/h, congress.gov 20,000/h.

panels.title: Completeness (last audit)
panels.description: Share of the records each source reports for the last few full days that are actually stored. Anything under 100% means records were silently dropped.

panels.title: Gaps found (7d)
panels.description: Audits that found missing records. Each one triggers a re-ingest of the window; gaps that keep coming back point at a bug in the ingest path.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.source, count(a.*) FILTER (WHERE a.missing > 0) AS gaps
FROM (VALUES ('congress'), ('regulations')) s(source)
LEFT JOIN v_completeness_audits a
  ON a.source = s.source AND a.audited_at > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY s.source ORDER BY s.source

panels.title: Recent audits
panels.description: Each audit asks the API how many records changed in the window and compares with Postgres.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT audited_at AS "audited", source,
       to_char(window_start, 'MM-DD') || ' to ' || to_char(window_end, 'MM-DD') AS "window",
       upstream_count AS "upstream", local_count AS "stored", missing, completeness
FROM v_completeness_audits
ORDER BY audited_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Model
panels.description: Whether the agent's last check found Ollama up with the model pulled.

panels.title: Agrees with CRS (7d)
panels.description: Shadow check: how often the model's policy area matches the official CRS one. Recent = last 7 days, baseline = the 30 days before.

panels.title: Gate failures (7d)
panels.description: Share of summaries still rejected by the validation gate after the retry.

panels.title: Agent step latency (p95)
panels.description: Per-step time for one bill: fetch context, build prompt, generate, validate, persist. 'generate' should dominate; anything else growing is a smell.

panels.title: Gate rejections by check (24h)
panels.description: Which validation checks reject model output most. Includes first attempts that the retry then fixed.

panels.title: Policy area drift (recent vs baseline)
panels.description: Jensen-Shannon divergence. 'output' is the model's picks, 'input' is the official areas of incoming bills. Output moving without input = the model changed, not the news.

panels.title: Grounded in source (median)
panels.description: Share of summary words found in the CRS text, median over the window. About 0.75 normally; 0.20 when the model was shown only titles and invented the rest. Too noisy for one summary, reliable over many.

panels.title: Recent reviewer rejections
panels.description: What humans caught that the validation gate didn't. Rejections the gate had not flagged are candidates for a new check.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT reviewed_at AS "rejected", bill_id AS "bill", reviewer, review_note AS "why",
       CASE WHEN had_validation_issues THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS "gate had flagged it"
FROM v_review_decisions
WHERE decision = 'rejected'
ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Daily activity
panels.description: Regulatory documents by posted date, bills by date of their latest action.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, kind AS metric, n AS value
FROM v_daily_activity
WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT agency_id AS agency, docs_last_7d AS "documents posted",
       open_for_comment AS "open for comment"
FROM v_agency_activity
ORDER BY docs_last_7d DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: Comment periods closing in the next 14 days
panels.description: Open regulations.gov comment periods closing soon. Click a title to open the document.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT comment_end_at AS "closes", agency_id AS "agency", document_type AS "type",
       title, docket_id AS "docket", url
FROM v_open_comment_periods
WHERE comment_end_at < now() + interval '14 days'
ORDER BY comment_end_at
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Latest bill actions
panels.description: Most recent actions on bills, linked to congress.gov.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(latest_action_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", upper(bill_type) || ' ' || bill_number AS "bill",
       title, latest_action_text AS "latest action", url
FROM v_bill_activity
WHERE latest_action_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY latest_action_date DESC, last_changed_at DESC
LIMIT 100
